name: Roasted coffee
definition: roasted coffee beans sold whole or ground (grind an attribute), including drip bags (a pack form).

name: Green coffee
definition: raw, unroasted coffee beans sold to roast.

name: Instant coffee
definition: Dried soluble coffee extract, including a dry mix when coffee is its largest ingredient by weight.

name: Coffee capsules & pods
definition: Single-serve capsule, E.S.E. pod or paper pad of coffee made to fit one machine system.

name: Coffee concentrate
definition: Liquid coffee extract sold to dilute, with coffee as its main ingredient; a sweetened or milk ready-to-drink is not included.

name: Cocoa beans
definition: whole cacao beans, raw, fermented and dried, or roasted.

name: Cocoa nibs
definition: cocoa beans cracked and shelled into pieces, raw or roasted.

name: Cocoa shells
definition: the shell of the cocoa bean, sold for infusion.

name: Cocoa paste
definition: Ground cocoa nibs set in a block or drops (cocoa liquor, ceremonial cacao); couverture and baking chocolate are in Pantry Staples.

name: Cocoa butter
definition: The fat pressed from cocoa paste.

name: Cocoa powder
definition: Unsweetened powder of pressed cocoa solids: natural, Dutch-process or black.

name: Drinking chocolate
definition: Sweetened cocoa powder for making a drink, with cocoa as its largest ingredient by weight; a sugar-led mix is not included.

name: White tea
definition: Camellia sinensis buds or young leaves withered and dried with little processing.

name: Steamed green tea
definition: unoxidised tea fixed by steaming, rolled and dried (sencha, bancha).

name: Shade-grown green tea
definition: green tea from bushes shaded before harvest, then steamed (gyokuro).

name: Pan-fired green tea
definition: unoxidised tea fixed by heating in a pan or drum (Long Jing, Bi Luo Chun).

name: Roasted green tea
definition: green tea roasted after fixing (hojicha).

name: Matcha
definition: shade-grown, steamed, unrolled tea leaf stone-ground to a fine powder.

name: Yellow tea
definition: green-processed tea given a slow sealed yellowing step before drying.

name: Oolong
definition: partly oxidised tea, bruised and rolled between withering and fixing.

name: Black tea
definition: Fully oxidised tea, made by the orthodox method or by CTC; the leaf grade is stated on the pack.

name: Pu-erh tea
definition: Post-fermented Yunnan large-leaf tea, raw (sheng) or ripe (shou), sold loose or pressed into cakes, tuo cha or bricks.

name: Other dark tea
definition: post-fermented tea other than pu-erh (Liu Bao, Liu'an).

name: Flavoured & scented tea
definition: tea of any base type scented, flavoured or blended with other ingredients (Earl Grey, jasmine tea, blooming tea, genmaicha).

name: Chai
definition: tea blended with spices to brew as chai.

name: Lemon verbena
definition: dried lemon verbena leaves sold for infusion.

name: Peppermint
definition: dried peppermint leaves sold for infusion.

name: Rooibos
definition: Dried, usually oxidised leaves and stems of Aspalathus linearis sold for infusion.

name: Yerba mate
definition: Dried, usually aged leaves and stems of Ilex paraguariensis sold for infusion.

name: Chamomile
definition: dried chamomile flowers sold for infusion.

name: Elderflower
definition: dried elder flowers sold for infusion.

name: Hibiscus
definition: dried hibiscus calyces and petals sold for infusion.

name: Lavender
definition: dried lavender flowers sold for infusion.

name: Fruit tea
definition: blend of dried fruit pieces sold for infusion.

name: Rose hip
definition: dried rose hips sold for infusion.

name: Ginger
definition: Dried ginger root sold for infusion; in a jar as a cooking spice it is in Pantry Staples.

name: Kava
definition: Ground root of Piper methysticum sold to prepare as a drink.

name: Roasted chicory
definition: Roasted chicory root sold to brew as a coffee substitute.

name: Turmeric
definition: Dried turmeric root sold for infusion; in a jar as a cooking spice it is in Pantry Staples.

name: Roasted barley tea
definition: Roasted barley grains sold to brew.

name: Herbal blend
definition: Blend of infusion plants from more than one plant part, none of which makes up half or more of its weight.

name: Honeybush
definition: dried, usually oxidised leaves and stems of Cyclopia sold for infusion.

name: Guayusa
definition: dried leaves of Ilex guayusa sold for infusion.

name: Lemongrass
definition: Dried lemongrass leaves sold for infusion; fresh stalks are in Fruit & Vegetables.

name: Spearmint
definition: dried spearmint leaves sold for infusion.

name: Mountain tea
definition: dried flowering stems of Sideritis sold for infusion.

name: Nettle leaf
definition: dried stinging-nettle leaves sold for infusion.

name: Birch leaf
definition: dried birch leaves sold for infusion.

name: Yarrow
definition: dried yarrow flowering tops sold for infusion.

name: Calendula
definition: dried calendula (pot marigold) flowers sold for infusion.

name: Marjoram
definition: Dried marjoram leaves and flowers sold for infusion; a jar of culinary dried herb is in Pantry Staples.

name: Chrysanthemum
definition: dried chrysanthemum flowers sold for infusion.

name: Kuding
definition: rolled dried leaves of Ilex kaushue or Ligustrum sold for infusion.
